description: MongoDB repository class for managing user data, providing methods to find users by email or ID and insert new users in the database.

classes.name: UsersRepository
classes.description: Provides data access methods for the users collection in MongoDB.

methods.name: __init__(self, db: Database)
methods.description: Initializes the repository with a MongoDB database instance and sets the users collection.

methods.name: dict[str,Any]|None find_by_email(self, email: str)
methods.description: Queries the users collection to find a user document matching the given email.

methods.name: str insert(self, user: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Inserts a new user document into the collection and returns the inserted document's ID as a string.

methods.name: dict[str,Any]|None find_by_id(self, user_id)
methods.description: Finds a user document by its ID.
